name: Nicholas Building (1906), 608 Madison Ave
refs: refs/w189371898/00-07 (Detroit Publishing Co. c.1905-1910, DPLA via Wikimedia Commons)
notes: 17 storeys: 2-storey stone base (storefronts + mezzanine) under a heavy belt; buff brick shaft with paired 1/1 sash between shallow piers, single windows in the end bays by wide corner piers; belt under the top floor; frieze and deep dentilled cornice.
